existing_contract_direction: C1 committed bootstrap_candidate consumption and atomic epoch close; draft remains draft

requirements.title: Consume the exact committed candidate lifecycle
requirements.requirement: Bind the original full ResultRequest, receipt key/request hash/result version, run/history, target generation and candidate/receipt/hold references. Never revive ExecutionHandle/CallSnapshot or accept a pre-commit observation as this consumer.
requirements.proof: Committed candidate succeeds only under independently authenticated bootstrap authority; structurally valid/rehashed replacements, acquired/published runs and stale target versions reject.

requirements.title: Authenticate the cross-owner mapping independently
requirements.requirement: A must bind the original OfflineBootstrapGrant, full disabled config, registry/ref set, policy/profile and exact producer scope/admission/target through a trusted original mapping. Neither matching DTOs nor matching hashes establish authorization.
requirements.proof: Changed database/installation/config/purpose/ref/profile and a self-consistent resealed alternative cannot authorize consumption. Existing direct nonce/CA paths retain their own reviewed scope.

requirements.title: Keep external work before transaction locks
requirements.requirement: Prepare original resource/TLS/permission/capability observations outside SQL locks. Locked checks use immutable original observations and caller SQL only; no network, provider call, new transaction or grant/handle issuance.
requirements.proof: Track provider calls and transaction boundaries; late guard and retry paths cannot start new external work or mint a refreshed observation.

requirements.title: Acquire one complete shared prefix in global order
requirements.requirement: Select every candidate key and the union of A bootstrap and producer locks before acquiring them. Follow existing C1 L0-L10 including absence ranges, stable within-layer ordering and exact FK actor keys. No complete GuardInTx policy may be injected after later A locks.
requirements.proof: Ordered lock trace covers installation/config absence, domain, admin, operation/receipt keys, grants/runs/history, targets/references/nonces, capacity, audits and evidence/chunks; a deliberately late early-layer acquisition is rejected.

requirements.title: Retain original transaction and authority identity
requirements.requirement: Any opaque prepared/locked/final object binds original service/context/tx/scope and complete candidate set, with no exported field constructor or caller-selected Policy that supplies permission.
requirements.proof: Zero, forged, replaced/copy-rebound scope/tx/context and changed candidate set reject without unauthorized SQL; no shared object creates an extra commit.

requirements.title: Resolve consumer deadline semantics before implementation
requirements.requirement: Distinguish committed-result consumption from producer execution. Specify each binding deadline from existing C1/A authority: original observation and admission validity, retention and current bootstrap authorization; explicitly decide original execution lease/owner-write-cutoff relevance rather than inheriting executionPolicy or arbitrarily restricting accepted committed results. Never extend original bounds or substitute fresh context.
requirements.proof: Include an otherwise valid committed candidate with expired execution lease but still-valid observation, plus observation equality/expiry, domain/admission expiry, cancellation and intermediate SQL-clock rollback; expected lease-case result must follow the recorded A/D decision.

requirements.title: Close the epoch atomically with disabled v1
requirements.requirement: In one caller-owned transaction write disabled config v1, installation/bootstrap operation/audits, precisely specified candidate reference transition and monotonic closed domain epoch/row-version CAS. Preserve original receipt/history and receipt/hold protection. No unbounded child-grant update or implicit live projection promotion.
requirements.proof: Successful readback proves config disabled, exact result/reference retention and closed incremented epoch; error at each write or final check rolls all changes back.

requirements.title: Place a fixed independent final guard before sole commit
requirements.requirement: All resource/authority/capacity callbacks and writes finish before final independent verification of original candidate evidence, references, expected post-close domain/config and original time/context. No later callback may mutate those facts.
requirements.proof: Late callback mutation and final-write wait/clock change fail shared rollback; legal expected closed-domain/config state succeeds rather than being mistaken for external drift.

requirements.title: Separate exact committed retry from new consumption
requirements.requirement: Current offline/bootstrap authorization remains mandatory. Exact prior success may return its original result under the agreed historical-read rule without a new candidate consume, epoch increment, activation, execution handle or observation refresh; changed request/key bindings conflict.
requirements.proof: Replay is read-only for candidate/domain/capacity; old observation cannot be renewed by retry, and changed current authority cannot read an otherwise matching success.

requirements.title: Preserve unknown commit and failure semantics
requirements.requirement: Bootstrap alone owns transaction completion. Commit response uncertainty returns unknown and requires stable operation-key readback, without reopening a domain, regenerating IDs or treating rollback as proof of no commit. Conservative capacity accounting has no fabricated release.
requirements.proof: Inject SQL/audit/CAS/cancel/unknown-commit failures and verify same-key resolution plus no second consume or authority renewal.

requirements.title: Keep captured authority out of output
requirements.requirement: Opaque original mapping/consumption state and diagnostic errors must not expose grant/domain/result/provider credentials or private descriptor material through value/pointer formatting or serialization.
requirements.proof: Constant formatting/rejected serialization for opaque objects; explicit sentinels absent from public errors and returned bootstrap response.

requirements.title: Verify the exact implementation and preserve previous evidence
requirements.requirement: Run meaningful affected package and shared-bootstrap regressions, boundary/order/rollback tests and relevant Linux builds with current source-set/bytes checks. Independent review must examine actual implementation and native outcomes. Keep prior GC/owner/remote receipts scoped to their frozen inputs, install no dependencies and remove exact run-owned test/build artifacts.
requirements.proof: Native complete results, source manifests, original failure counterexamples where used, affected-scope preservation and exact owner cleanup; model success alone is not production, grant or actual SQL approval.

open_contract_decisions: trusted original OfflineBootstrapGrant to C1 admission/target/reference mapping issuer
committed consumer original execution lease versus observation/current bootstrap authority semantics
complete union prefix and exact candidate reference disposition/closed-domain expected final state
